newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: SOCCER-UAE REACH QUARTER-FINALS WITH 2-0 WIN OVER INDONESIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UAE REACH QUARTER-FINALS WITH 2-0 WIN OVER INDONESIA.

text.p: Hosts the United Arab Emirates advanced to the quarter-finals of the Asian Cup with a 2-0 (1-0 halftime) victory over Indonesia in a group A match on Tuesday.
Indonesia's second defeat in three matches eliminated them from the 12-nation tournament.
Second-placed South Korea only a need a draw against Kuwait in the final group A match later on Tuesday to qualify for the next stage.
The UAE grabbed the lead in the 14th minute when a sliding Hassan Ahmed latched onto a ball by Adnan Al Talyani to score from close range.
Talyani was denied in the 35th minute by a brilliant tackle inside the penalty area by defender Aples Tecuari as he appeared to be running clear on goal.
Indonesia started the second term brightly and came close to scoring three minutes after the break when Ronny Wabia hit the post.
The UAE quickly reasserted their control and in the 64th minute were also denied by the woodwork, but a minute later made sure of their chance and were 2-0 up.
Indonesian goalkeeper Hendro Kartiko fumbled a low cross by substitute Zuhair Bakhait and the ball fell to Talyani who hammered it home from 10 metres out.

UAE: 17-Muhsin Fairouz; 2-Abdel Hussain; 3-Munther Abdullah; 6-Ismail Ismail; 7-Bakhit Saad (11-Zuhair Bakhit 46) ; 10-Adnan Al Talyani; 12-Hassan Mubarak; 13-Abdulaziz Mohamed; 16-Hassan Ahmed; 18-Ahmed Ahmed; 23-Adel Ahmed.

Indonesia: 20-Hendro Kartiko; 3-Suwandi Siswoyo; 4-Yeyen Tumera; 5-Aples Tecuari; 6-Sudiriman; 7-Widodo Gahyo Purta; 8- Ronny Wabia; 11-Bima Sakti; 15-Francis Wewengken; 16-Marzuki Badriawan (14-Anshar Razak 59); 18-Supriyono.
